chapter: Early 1930s: Bessie Smith, Rex Stewart and the Harlem scene
title: First visit to the Savoy and hearing Rex with Fletcher Henderson
summary: The Brown Brothers took him to the Savoy where he heard Fletcher Henderson's band with Coleman Hawkins, Walter Johnson and Rex Stewart.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: I mean, he was a different person than I thought he would be. The first time I saw him playing with Fletcher Henderson... The first time I went to the Savoy,

the Brown Brothers took me, and there on the bandstand was Fletcher Henderson. Who else was there... Well, they had two bandstands at the Savoy. But when they played, I was so taken, man! I was so astounded at the way these musicians played. They had Walter Johnson on the drums, you know, Coleman Hawkins and... Yeah, that was the set-up there. Oh, what a great band that was. Whoo! Bobby Stark... And then, when Rex Stewart starts screaming on the trumpet, you know, I thought he was a fantastic... I thought he was a rebel, you know, the way he...
To some people, but not to me!
But he wasn't by any means a pal. He was sort of a bit rebellious in that way.
